title: Reference embedding evaluation harness and drift signal pipeline
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a modular, reproducible evaluation harness for embedding accuracy and reranker quality that can run offline batch jobs, produce stable baselines, and feed automated drift detection. The harness will: 1) maintain verified reference suites (anchor/reference sets) with provenance and per-example meta; 2) compute a standard set of offline metrics (cosine/similarity distributions, MAP@k, Recall@k, nDCG, calibration of similarity thresholds, embedding distance histograms, embedding variance by doc length); 3) compare model variants (quantized, fp16, fused kernels) and routing fallbacks; 4) incorporate statistical tests for significance and power; 5) surface signal to the Console and trigger alerts when quality/regression thresholds breach; and 6) provide lightweight per-customer drift hooks for customers on Dedicated/Private deployments. This ticket focuses on the first phase: schema for reference suites, core metric implementations, a reproducible runner (Spark/Dataproc or EMR alternative), and a minimal Grafana dashboard + PagerDuty rule for drift alarms.
tasks: Define reference-set schema (id, source, label, shard, provenance_url, generation_hash, evaluation_tag)
Create tooling to ingest and version reference suites into S3 with immutable paths and human-readable manifests
Implement metric library: cosine distribution, MAP@k, Recall@k, nDCG, embedding entropy, intra-class variance
Add model-variant comparator to produce delta reports (baseline vs candidate) and per-example failure logs
Design sampling/stratification for large corpora to keep nightly runs under budget
Wire batch runner (Docker + k8s CronJob) to execute evaluation and write JSON+Parquet outputs
Create Grafana panels and an initial Console route that displays latest run, deltas, and top-k failure examples
Integrate simple alerting: threshold rules for % drop in MAP@10 and distribution shift via KL-divergence; send to PagerDuty channel
Add CI job to validate metric implementations and run a smoke evaluation on small reference set before deploy
Document runbook for adding new reference sets and interpreting alerts
acceptance_criteria: Reference-set schema documented and example suite uploaded to s3://redwood-evals/reference-suites/ENG-10421/
Evaluation runner can execute end-to-end in less than 2 hours on staging data (configurable sampling)
Core metric library implemented with unit tests and published as internal PyPI package @redwood/emb-eval
Comparator produces human-readable delta report and per-example CSV of worst regressions
Grafana dashboard shows baseline vs candidate metrics and top 20 example failures
PagerDuty alert fires when MAP@10 drops by >3% or KL divergence of embedding distribution exceeds threshold and a test alert flow is validated
PR with code + docs merged and deployment manifests added to infra repo
risks: High compute cost if reference sets are large; need careful sampling and incremental compute
Label noise in reference suites could produce false positives—requires periodic manual audit
Drift thresholds tuned too aggressively may cause alert fatigue; need staged rollout
Cross-tenant privacy: storing customer examples for Dedicated/Private customers requires opt-in and KMS wrapping
Comparing quantized vs fp16 embeddings requires matching preprocessing to avoid spurious deltas
